## Elasticflow MCP Server

Elasticflow is an AI-native workspace for business — a single place where AI agents and the team work together on structured data, documents, files, and live dashboards.

This remote MCP server exposes 46 tools across 5 surfaces (workspaces, tables, documents, files, interfaces) so any MCP client can read business data, produce durable artifacts, and publish results that the whole organization sees — not lose them in a chat thread.

**Key capabilities**

- **Durable artifacts, not chat messages.** Every table row, document, and dashboard an agent creates is a first-class object the team can open, edit, and share.
- **Closed-loop operations.** Agents read live data, take action, produce artifacts, and the org sees results in the same workspace.
- **Permissioned by design.** Fine-grained OAuth 2.1 scopes (read/write per resource type) let you delegate narrowly and safely.
- **Modular install.** Use the full `/mcp` endpoint (46 tools) or scoped sub-servers (`/data`, `/content`, `/platform`) to stay under your client's tool limit.
- **Enterprise-ready.** SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3, 99.9% uptime SLA.

**Typical use cases**

- Sales — maintain a live pipeline, enrich leads, generate weekly summaries, publish client portals
- Legal — track contracts, monitor renewals, search NDAs for specific clauses
- Marketing — run a campaign tracker, calculate CPL/CAC, auto-generate monthly reports
- Finance — reconcile invoices, flag budget overruns, generate scheduled P&L summaries
- HR — parse resumes into a candidate table, track hiring stages
- Operations — manage inventory, suppliers, orders; publish fulfillment dashboards

Authentication is OAuth 2.1 with PKCE — no API keys or tokens to configure. Sign up at https://www.elasticflow.app.
